`claude-banner-real.txt` is the terminal banner excerpt published by the reporter in [anthropics/claude-code#1757](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/1757), retrieved through the GitHub issue API on 2026-11-02. It preserves the original block and box-drawing characters.

`claude-banner-quadrant.txt` reproduces the compact quadrant logo supplied in TASK-ft16, with representative adjacent version/model/path lines. It supplements the real captured banner with the modern layout and is not claimed as a live capture.
